query:
SELECT m.id, m.senderId, m.recipientId, u.name as senderName, u2.name as recipientName, m.content, m.bookingId, m.createdAt
FROM messages m
JOIN users u ON m.senderId = u.id
JOIN users u2 ON m.recipientId = u2.id
WHERE (u.email = 'test-mentee@test.com' AND u2.name = '이윤호')
   OR (u.name = '이윤호' AND u2.email = 'test-mentee@test.com')
ORDER BY m.createdAt DESC;
